summary.name: Line Art (Drawing and Illustration). The label was normalized from source descriptions, so its provenance is not an original named source.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: Line Art describes objects through contours, structural lines and limited internal detail. It uses a consistent line-weight hierarchy on a simple background, with small accent colors for emphasis. Components are revealed or moved while joints stay connected and stroke widths stay controlled.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: elegant product or icon reveals work alone, while technical explanation or editorial layouts suit it when paired. Inferred: engineering teardowns, science mechanisms, brand stories and architecture features fit its structural contours. Avoid Animated Line Art as a near-duplicate.
summary.limitations: Explicit: Rough.js sketch treatment is allowed only when the brief calls for it, and never on precise grids, clean vectors, product UI, pixel clusters, photoreal materials or existing assets. Hachure and pattern fills do not create authentic pencil, ink or print media. Avoid filled shapes and misleading scale.
summary.palette: Suggested, not approved: background #FAF8F1 as the quiet field, foreground #273D42 for lines and text, and accent #B77843 for emphasis. Task-supplied exact colors override these. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 10.785:1 and suits body text. Accent on background measures 3.418:1, so it is decorative only; use #B77843 only for active elements.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: reveals use stroke length or path segments, with GSAP DrawSVGPlugin or Motion owning each animated property. Movement should be smooth where it helps, while cuts, impacts, reading holds and constant-speed sections stay deliberate. motion-012 and motion-015 are optional scene patterns, scheduled by time for video. motion-039 is optional only when assets support its outlined mark and rays, omitting filled particles and glow. Interactive delivery is unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified: the style requires no audio layer. Music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience or silence may be proposed from topic, audience and motion. Inferred: restrained options or silence suit reading holds and precise line work. Do not invent audio assets. Music timing needs real audio analysis, and motion-039 has no verified music synchronization.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: no approved mark, source artwork, exact copy or fonts are supplied. Store contours as paths, and load fonts and assets before rendering. Inspect glyphs or mark geometry before using motion-039. Optional tldraw export must keep editable layers and match the installed SDK's verified export APIs.
summary.combinations: style-097 suits mechanism explanation: the object reveals by stroke, labelled stages follow, and #B77843 marks only the active part. style-019 suits editorial layouts: #273D42 is used for line and text, section backgrounds stay uncolored, and figures stay within grid frames. Both require an outline greater than structure greater than detail line hierarchy.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: SVG paths for clean contours, optional tldraw assets, Paper.js for precise curves, and Rough.js or three.js outlines only when authorized. Motion engine: GSAP DrawSVGPlugin for stroke reveals on a paused timeline. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion only when its fallback condition is verified. Verify direct and reverse seeks and decoded frames.
